label: M1 the drain subtracts 1001 instead of COW_NET_CLOCK_MS_NEG (0x100dbfba-0x100dbfbf): the loop still ends, but the accumulator comes back one high on every state that carries
M2 the carry test read as > instead of >= (0x100dbfa4/0x100dbfca): the state whose accumulator lands exactly on 1000 must drain to 0
M3 the gap of exactly zero is dropped like a negative one (0x100dbf41's `jl` becomes a `jle`): the state where the tick did not move must still drain what the accumulator already holds
find: if ((int32_t)delta >= 0) /* 0x100dbf3f-0x100dbf41: signed - a tick that went backwards is dropped */
replace: if ((int32_t)delta > 0) /* MUTANT: a zero gap is treated as backwards */

label: M4 the debt cap inverted (`spend > neg_delta`): the state with drift -50 and a 1024 ms gap banks 974 instead of 1004 and never carries. This is the mistake the seeds were written for - the first version of the conversion made exactly it
M5 the positive bank is not capped at COW_NET_CLOCK_DRIFT_MAX (0x100dbf7a dropped) - the state with drift 50 spends all of it
replace: /* MUTANT: no cap on the credit */

label: M6 the limit comparison for entering the clamp read as < instead of <= (0x100dbf57): the state with a gap of exactly 20 and a drift of 30 would spend it
M7 edx is not left at the -1000 the loop loads at 0x100dbfa9
M8 the store of the new tick is dropped (0x100dbf3d) - even the path that banks nothing must consume the tick
find: clock->tick_last = tick; /* 0x100dbf3d, on every path, through the pointer loaded at 0x100dbf27 */

label: M9 the three pushes are collapsed into the bridge (0x100dbf2f dropped) - on a state where the clock pointer faults the original has already made this write

g->esp -= 4u; /* 0x100dbf2f: push esi - the new tick goes on the stack BEFORE the stored one is
                     read, and that order is not decoration: on a state where the clock pointer is junk
                     the entry faults at the read, with this one write already made */
    wr32(g->esp, tick);
